testData.intro:
Scenarios refer to data by the part it plays, not by name — any environment with this shape will
do. Where a step says "any", the choice does not affect the outcome.

placeholders.mustBe: A Platform admin
Someone with no Account; Email address 1 is theirs and no Account uses it
Someone with no Account; Email address 2 is theirs and no Account uses it
Someone with no Account; Email address 3 is theirs and no Account uses it
An Organizer, with Owner 1 an Owner on its Team
Managers on Organizer 1's Team, and on no other Team
A Manager on Organizer 1's Team and on no other Team, who holds a Ticket they bought for any Performance
Another Organizer, whose Team is Owner 2, its only Owner, and Manager 4

scenarios.title: an Organizer is onboarded with its first Owner, who signs in and adds a Manager

steps.action: Open "Organizers" and click "Onboard organizer"
Enter any name in "Organizer name"
Enter Person 1's name in "Name" and Email address 1 in "Email address"
Click "Onboard"

steps.action: Sign out
Open the invitation sent to Email address 1 and click "Choose your password"
Enter any valid password in "Password" and click "Set password"

results: signed in as Person 1, with the new Organizer's "Team" offered

steps.action: Open "Team" and click "Add team member"
Enter Email address 2 in "Email address" and Person 2's name in "Name"
Choose "Manager" in "Team role" and click "Add"
results: "Team member added"
"Team" lists Person 1 as "Owner" and Person 2 as "Manager"
an invitation to choose a password arrives at Email address 2

scenarios.title: Someone who registered as an Attendee joins a Team with the same Account

steps.action: Click "Register"
Enter Visitor 1's name in "Name" and Email address 3 in "Email address"
Enter any valid password in "Password" and click "Create account"
results: signed in as Visitor 1

steps.action: Sign out, and sign in as Owner 1
Open "Team" and click "Add team member"
Enter Email address 3 in "Email address"

steps.action: Sign out, and sign in with Email address 3 and the password Visitor 1 chose in step 3
results: signed in as Visitor 1, with Organizer 1's "Team" offered

steps.action: Open "Team"
results: Visitor 1 is listed once, as "Manager"

steps.action: Sign out and click "Register"
Fill in the form with any name, Email address 3 and any valid password, and click "Create account"
results: refused: "An account already uses this email address"

scenarios.title: A Manager cannot add, remove or change the Team role of anyone on the Team

results: Owner 1 is listed as "Owner" and Manager 2 as "Manager"

steps.action: Open "My tickets"

testData.intro:
Scenarios refer to data by the part it plays, not by name — any environment with this shape will
do. Where a step says "any", the choice does not affect the outcome.

Every Performance below is of a *Published* Event of Organizer 1 unless it says otherwise.
Performances 1, 2, 3, 6 and 7 are still to come, with their Doors time not yet reached. Performances
4 and 5 are **open for scanning now**: their Doors time has passed and their Start time was less
than 90 minutes ago. Performances 4 and 5 are at Venue 1, whose Doors are "Door 1" and "Door 2".

placeholders.mustBe: An Organizer, with Manager 1 a Manager on its Team
Door staff on Organizer 1's Team, and on no other Team
Another Organizer, with Manager 2 a Manager on its Team and on no other Team
Performance 1 offers a Ticket type, Standard, with Availability of at least 3, and has no *Confirmed* Orders; Attendee 1 has no Orders for it
Performance 2 offers Standard, with Availability of at least 1, and has no *Confirmed* Orders; Attendee 2's only Order for it is *Expired*, with no Payment
Performance 3 has a *Confirmed* Order by Attendee 3; Attendee 4 is on no Organizer's Team and has no Orders for it
Performance 4 has exactly three Tickets, none Checked in: Ticket 1 and Ticket 2 held by Attendee 5, its Buyer, and Ticket 3 held by Attendee 6, its Buyer
Performance 5 has no Ticket Checked in. Performance 6 is another Performance of Organizer 1; Attendee 7 holds Ticket 4, for Performance 6
Performance 9 is a Performance of Organizer 2, open for scanning now; Attendee 8 holds Ticket 5, for Performance 9
Ticket 6 is for Performance 5, bought by Attendee 9 and transferred before its Doors time to Attendee 10, who holds it, not Checked in; Old code 6 is the Ticket code it had before the Transfer
Attendee 11 bought, and holds, exactly two Standard Tickets for Performance 7, Ticket 7 and Ticket 8, on one *Confirmed* Order
Someone with no Account; Email address 1 is theirs and no Account uses it
Attendee 12 holds Ticket 9, for Performance 5, not Checked in

scenarios.title: A card approved after the Hold ran out, once its tickets are gone, is refunded automatically
scenarios.setup: sign in as Attendee 11 in one browser, and as Attendee 12 in another

steps.action: As Attendee 11, check out 2 Standard for Performance 10
results: the Order is shown as "Pending payment"; note its "Tickets held until"

steps.action: Click "Pay"
results: the Payment provider's page opens

steps.action: Wait on the Payment provider's page until the "Tickets held until" time has passed
As Attendee 12, check out 2 Standard for Performance 10
results: Attendee 12's Order is shown as "Pending payment"

steps.action: As Attendee 11, pay with a card the Payment provider approves
results: back on the Order: "Payment refunded: these tickets were no longer available"
